tv.note: GE06 Band III plan (ch 5-12, 7 MHz). Most countries now use Band III for DAB: check the DAB blocks first. Russia, Belarus and Ukraine number 8 MHz VHF channels (R6-R12), and Italy has an older lettered VHF plan: this table is wrong there.
Channel N lower edge = 302 + 8N MHz. 694-790 became the 700 MHz mobile band in the EU (Decision (EU) 2017/899); 470-694 kept for TV to 2030. Some transmitters sit about 0.167 MHz off centre.
